action.reason: Slow spans and dependency hints alone do not prove timeouts or domain faults; measuring observed dependencies via traces is needed to localize the delayed order processing.

Slow spans and messaging dependency hints alone do not prove timeouts or domain faults; mapping the checkout service topology will localize which downstream dependency (db, redis, kafka, rpc) is involved in the delayed order processing.

The only dependency hint is a messaging producer/consumer operation ('publish orders') on the slow checkout path; a Kafka expert can measure whether that observed dependency is actually delaying order processing, rather than collecting more generic symptoms.
